title: Chicagoland Skydiving Center
specs: First and only solar-powered skydiving facility in the world
On-site full service restaurant and bar with beer garden
Minimum age 18 years, no parental consent forms
Weight limit 250 lbs; surcharges apply for weights 200-220 lbs ($25), 221-240 lbs ($35), 241-250 lbs ($45)
Group discounts available: 3-5 people $20 off per person, 6-10 people $30 off per person, 11+ people $40 off per person; group organizer jumps free
Private group rentals, group transportation, discounted hotel rooms, reserved seating, catering packages available
Facility accommodates events from 10 to 400 guests with catering and event services

services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Skydiving safety really comes down to one thing: managing the factors you can control. Skydiving is a very dynamic activity, full of variables that matter for safety. Like any other inherently risky activity, the proper preparations mean it can be enjoyed safely. The primary things that affect safety in our sport are: training, equipment, aircraft, weather and enforcing standards and rules. The readers of Blue Skies Magazine voted CSC the Best Safety Culture, and that’s an award we’re proud to hold. CSC is one of the safest places to skydive in the world. services.name: First Skydive
services.desc: A skydive mentor program designed to give you the skills to become the best skydiver possible The biggest advantage to jumping at Chicagoland Skydiving Center is the people. Period. We have a team of passionate mentors who have chosen to give back to the sport that has given them so much. Who better to learn from? At most drop zones, newer jumpers get lost in the shuffle. They are no longer being handled by the instructional staff and they don't have enough experience to jump with most licensed jumpers. We wanted to change that. We've all been a newbie at some point. blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving jumps from altitudes of 9,000', 14,000', or 18,000' with oxygen available for the highest jump. The facility includes a full-service restaurant and bar, spectator areas, and event spaces for groups and private parties. Group skydiving packages and discounts are available, and the center emphasizes safety with a perfect student safety record.
